verdict.rationale: Expensify documents travel booking (flights/hotels/cars/rail) alongside SmartScan receipt capture and BYOC card support, which together could populate a trip report, but there's no explicit documentation of itinerary-linked auto-consolidation tying bookings+card charges+receipts into one report. Community evidence directly contradicts the 'automatic, accurate' framing of SmartScan: users report ~70% miscategorization and that receipt data was processed by low-paid, unvetted Mechanical Turk workers who could see PII, undermining the 'collect themselves' promise. Missing for 10: explicit itinerary-report linking mechanism, and resolution of the accuracy/privacy contradiction in receipt processing.
